component.name: tifea
component.summary: Atomic transactional installer for prebuilt desktop tarballs

description.p: TIFEA is a declarative, self-healing transactional installer and package manager for raw desktop application tarballs (.tar.gz, .tar.xz).

Key features include atomic execution ledger with LIFO rollback, automated Electron sandbox confinement (AppArmor, setuid, or no-sandbox), icon and metadata extraction from ASAR bundles, Desktop entry registration, and xdg-mime URL handler binding.
